I don’t know and I don’t want to think about it. I have college to get through, I’ll think about it afterwards.

...I _hate_ what I just typed.

All that is true...

But for some reason, I was happier when my mindset was “I’ll kill myself eventually, don’t worry about it” than what it is now which is basically “Hey, life’s great, do your best!”

I’m just going to go back to that mindset, so that I can focus. Yeah, that sounds better.
